thread:
jess (Docs): Heads-up — I opened PR #4823 with the migration guide updates and the SDK snippet fixes. Need reviewers and a merge slot before next release cutoff.

oliver (Eng): Thanks, linking the PR?

jess (Docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — main things: versioned API table update, new python SDK example, and a short note about feature flag behavior for v2 models.

sam (PM): Is this targeting the 2026.03 release? Cutoff is Friday 16:00 PT, right?

maria (Release): Correct — Friday 16:00 PT. If you miss the window, it goes to next minor.

jess (Docs): We need at least one eng review + one docs review and CI/docs preview green. @oliver can you take the API table and feature-flag paragraph? @sam can you sanity-check the migration wording?

oliver (Eng): I can review today. Quick skim: are there any codegen implications for clients pinned to older model IDs?

jess (Docs): I added a short callout recommending customers pin exact model versions or enable fallback routing. Not a deep change to behavior, just docs guidance.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #4823 — unit tests (12), lint, docs-build, preview deploy. Status: running.

devex-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4823--docs.redwood.ai/ — note: preview uses canary routes so screenshots may differ from prod.

sam (PM): Looks good. One tiny wording nit in migration guide about token limits. I'll drop an inline comment.

oliver (Eng): Just left a technical comment re: fallback example — suggest adding this snippet:

```
# python sdk: prefer pinned model, fallback to cost-effective model
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-v2.1", fallback="redwood-v2-quant")
```

jess (Docs): Thanks, added that snippet and updated the preview.

ci-bot: docs-build failed — error: broken relative link in /guides/migration.md line 42 -> ../examples/old-api.md (404).

jess (Docs): Ack, that link was a stale path from earlier refactor. Fixing now.

oliver (Eng): I can spare 30m to re-review once CI passes. We should aim to merge in the Tue afternoon slot so release team can validate.

maria (Release): Tue afternoon works, but we need final approvals by Tue 13:00 PT to make internal verification before the public cut. Otherwise it's later.

jess (Docs): Fixed link, pushed. New preview: https://deploy-preview-4823--docs.redwood.ai/ (updated).

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #4823 — all checks green.

sam (PM): Approving the migration wording from product side.

oliver (Eng): Approving technical changes. No blockers from runtime.

jess (Docs): Two approvals — thank you! Scheduling merge for Tue 12:30 PT. Tagging release: @maria please confirm this slot is ok.

maria (Release): Confirmed. We'll include it in the verification run. Please note feature-flag rollouts must be gated if the toggle is set to off by default. Add a note in the PR description about required FF state.

jess (Docs): Added note: "Feature flag FF_MIGRATION_DOCS must be enabled in staging during verification".

sam (PM): One more ask — can we add a short SDK JS snippet for parity? A 2-line example.

jess (Docs): Added JS example. Preview updated.

ci-bot: Merge scheduled by jess at 1869460200 (Tue 12:30 PT).

devex-bot: Post-merge task: regenerate sidebar index and schedule docs cache invalidation.

jess (Docs): Merged. Thanks everyone! Will follow up if verifier flags anything. :tada:

maria (Release): Running verification now. If any late regressions, we'll open a hotfix flow.

sam (PM): Great job — smooth coordination.

oliver (Eng): Nice. Filing a small follow-up to track telemetry for the fallback example (so we can see adoption).

jess (Docs): Filed follow-up issue #5030 for telemetry tracking. Thread closed.
